sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and Customary Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) - active regional trade agreement
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement - active regional trade agreement
No bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently identified as in force specifically for Vanuatu International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act No. 33 of 1992 (Cap. 222, as amended), including subsequent beneficial ownership amendments; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2016 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act [Cap. 290]; Financial Services Commission Act 2017 (as amended); and applicable VFSC/FIU customer due diligence and beneficial ownership regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of valid passport or national identity document of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of residence; apostille issued by designated competent authority under Hague Apostille Convention
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization via Vanuatu diplomatic/consular intermediary if origin country is not party to the Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (bank statement or utility bill dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or utility provider in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for non-Apostille countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional banker's reference letter or bank good-standing letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account bank or correspondent bank in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for non-Apostille countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate good-standing certificate and register extract if a corporate shareholder or corporate UBO is involved
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry or licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization via Vanuatu diplomatic/consular intermediary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Completed KYC/CDD questionnaire and source-of-funds declaration signed by each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent with VFSC approval
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature with Hague Apostille where required; otherwise scanned wet-ink original retained in CDD file

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers and material shareholders against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, FATF public statements, Interpol notices, and domestic Vanuatu FIU/VFSC advisories. Politically exposed persons, high-risk jurisdictions and prospective beneficial owners must receive enhanced due diligence. CDD records must be retained for at least five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) eServices / Company Registry Portal - vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages are Bislama, English and French. Names must be submitted in Latin script. Foreign-script names must be transliterated into English or French. The name of an International Company must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated' or 'Inc' as required by the International Companies Act. No statutory requirement exists to register a local-script version.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of rejection, stating why the name is not prohibited, offensive or contrary to the International Companies Act. VFSC will issue a written determination. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may submit a revised name or seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. A name reservation may be extended for an additional 30-day period before expiry, subject to payment of the applicable VFSC extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a substitute for the statutory registered office. A physical registered office address in Vanuatu, provided by a VFSC-licensed registered agent, is mandatory for a B2B enterprise SaaS International Company. Virtual office mailing and forwarding services may only supplement the physical registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 15-25% probability of unannounced VFSC or Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit on-site inspection during the first 12 months for a low-risk, unlicensed B2B SaaS International Company. The probability rises materially above 60% if any adverse media, sanctions hit or PEP-related trigger occurs, or if the registered agent is selected for a VFSC supervision inspection cycle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name search and reservation fee (primary name and one alternative)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory VFSC fee schedule, converted from VUV at prevailing exchange rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC International Company incorporation filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory VFSC fee schedule for standard International Company incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent fee, including registered office address and company secretary services for Year 1
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed VFSC registered agent in Port Vila
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Port Vila market benchmark; USD 800-1,200 for low-risk IC

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT customer due diligence and UBO register setup by licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; includes CDD file, PEP/sanctions screening and UBO register preparation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Hague Apostille and certified translation of passport, proof of address and banker's reference
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country notary, apostille competent authority and sworn translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for international document legalization

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Secure courier and digital KYC document transmission to Vanuatu registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International courier service / digital verification provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incumbency ordered at incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory VFSC fee plus registered agent administrative fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory minimum capital requirement and capital duty
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Not applicable under International Companies Act [Cap. 222]
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory minimum capital requirement and no capital duty for Vanuatu International Companies

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Republic of Vanuatu, as amended, principally sections 4 to 15 (incorporation, memorandum and articles, registered office, registered agent, and certificate of incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registry of International Companies, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association accompanied by VFSC incorporation application form for an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued or paid-up capital; shares may be denominated in any currency, and no escrow, deposit, or capitalization obligation is imposed at incorporation for a Vanuatu International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription of ordinary shares by the founding subscriber is hereby approved, ratified, and recorded as fully issued; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office at the address maintained by the registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu is adopted as the Company's statutory registered office; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the appointed licensed registered agent is retained in accordance with the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the named individuals are appointed as founding Directors and the named individual is appointed as Company Secretary, each with full authority to open bank accounts, engage professional advisers, submit regulatory filings, and execute any documents required to implement these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies, online portal and email submission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name, together with the registered agent engagement letter and identity documents of ultimate beneficial owners, to the VFSC Registry for preliminary clearance. On clearance, the name is reserved for 28 days and the reservation receipt is retained for submission.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and secondary name (if any)
Duly completed VFSC name clearance application
Passport copy or national ID of each intended director, shareholder, and beneficial owner
Signed registered agent engagement letter
Proof of registered office address confirmation with service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as undesirable, misleading, or conflicting with an existing registered name, file a fresh name application with an alternative name or submit written consent from the existing registrant and supporting evidence for reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, notarization, and execution of constitutive documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent and local notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association under the International Companies Act. Arrange execution by the subscriber and intended directors before a notary public or other recognized witness as required by VFSC practice. Include registered office and registered agent consents.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association
Articles of Association
Consent of registered agent
Consent of registered office provider
Consent to act as director
Consent to act as company secretary
Certificate of good standing or passport copies for all officers and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the form or content of the constitutive documents, prepare a corrected execution page or supplementary board statement and re-submit to the registered agent within 10 business days; no re-notarization is required unless the substance changes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application and settlement of statutory fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Memorandum and Articles, VFSC incorporation application form, consents, and beneficial ownership information in the prescribed electronic or paper format. Pay the VFSC incorporation fee and any expedited fee requested.
required_dossiers: Executed incorporation application form
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consents of registered agent, registered office, directors, and secretary
Certified passport copies and proof of residential address for each shareholder and director
Applicable VFSC fee payment reference or receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected or placed under query, the registered agent submits written clarifications, corrected schedules, or supplementary KYC documents within 14 days to avoid automatic withdrawal; VFSC generally allows two rounds of amendment before requiring a fresh application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and registration status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review and fee clearance, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and enters the International Company into the public register. The registered agent physically or electronically delivers the certificate, and the company becomes a separate legal person from the date of incorporation.
required_dossiers: VFSC incorporation approval notice
Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Registered agent's filing acknowledgment
Void checks or signed standing instructions for annual VFSC fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains clerical or transcription errors, file a VFSC request for certificate correction or re-issue; if the certificate is not issued within the SLA, escalate through the registered agent to the VFSC Registry supervisor with the filing error receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation governance setup and statutory record maintenance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent and first board of directors of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting to adopt the pro-forma board resolution, issue share certificates, appoint the registered agent and officers, approve the appointment of bank signatories, and adopt the minute book. Maintain all statutory records at the registered office in Vanuatu and pay any initial annual fee to VFSC.
required_dossiers: First board resolution and board meeting minutes
Share certificates and register of members
Register of directors and company secretary
Registered office register and registered agent consent
VFSC annual fee payment calendar and receipt
Corporate governance manual and banking authority forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If governance filings are deficient, circulate a written consent resolution in lieu of a board meeting, execute the missing register pages, and file corrected officer particulars with VFSC through the registered agent; late VFSC annual fees attract penalties and can be cured by payment and an explanatory letter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Ministry of Trade, Tourism and Industry — no industrial manufacturing licensing requirement applies to ISIC 6201 enterprise SaaS software development
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating license is mandated for enterprise cloud software application development under Vanuatu law; an optional municipal business license from the Port Vila City Council may apply to physical office premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — non-industrial, office-based software development activity involving no manufacturing, no point-source discharge, and de minimis office waste
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No domestic industrial discharge thresholds apply. Office wastewater is limited to municipal sewer systems; electronic waste shall be disposed through licensed e-waste handlers in accordance with Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations; no VOC emissions are generated from code development, hosting, or SaaS operations; ambient noise must conform to municipal nuisance standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service for the registered physical office; structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department for any fit-out or occupancy conversion; occupational health and safety workplace clearance for low-risk office occupancy, including fire exits, electrical safety, and emergency lighting.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA) | portal: vrc.vu; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) acts as company registry and International Company regulator
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entity must: (1) incorporate as an International Company under the International Companies Act Cap. 222 through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; (2) obtain Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles, and registered office certificate; (3) submit to VRCA Port Vila a VAT registration form with the incorporation bundle, beneficial ownership declaration, and director/shareholder identification; (4) receive the assigned VAT/TIN registration number effective from the date of registration. Registration is mandatory for any supplier whose taxable turnover reaches or exceeds VT 2,000,000 in any consecutive 12-month period; voluntary registration below the threshold is available to exporters seeking input VAT recovery.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US check-the-box or ATAD hybrid mismatch elections exist in Vanuatu. Statutory elections available: (a) voluntary VAT registration under s.8(3) of the VAT Act No. 12 of 1998 for below-threshold exporters; (b) election of International Company legal form conferring complete domestic tax immunity under Part 4 of the International Companies Act Cap. 222; (c) election to maintain strict offshore-only activity to preserve exemption from VAT, income tax, and withholding tax; (d) no VAT group registration mechanism applies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 2,000,000 (approximately USD 17,200) of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; voluntary registration permitted below threshold for exporters
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API-based continuous transactional control, or digital stamping mandate is in force. E-invoicing is permissible but not cleared by government systems. VAT invoices must be issued within 5 business days of supply, bilateral French/English acceptable, and accounting records retained for 10 years for VRCA inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under s.24 of the VAT Act to (a) goods physically exported from Vanuatu within prescribed timelines, and (b) services supplied to a non-resident recipient effectively used/enjoyed outside Vanuatu. For B2B Enterprise SaaS (ISIC 6201), the supply qualifies where the customer is located outside Vanuatu, the SaaS platform is accessed offshore, and no local Vanuatu consumption occurs.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA/VRCA export entry) for goods; not applicable to pure SaaS, replaced by contract
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, or internationally recognized digital delivery certificate / server log evidence for services
Executed SaaS subscription agreement / purchase order evidencing the offshore recipient and place of consumption
Inward remittance certificate, SWIFT advice, or Stripe/Wise settlement statements proving collection of foreign-denominated proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no statutory foreign exchange control or repatriation deadline. VRCA may reverse zero-rating where substantiation is inadequate, reassess VAT at 15%, charge late payment interest, impose penalty tax up to 100% of the evaded amount under ss.99–100 of the VAT Act, and pursue criminal prosecution for fraudulent evasion with fines up to VT 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years (s.147 VAT Act). Retrospective assessments may extend over 6 years. An International Company conducting any Vanuatu-source domestic business without a local business license forfeits its statutory tax-exempt status and becomes fully exposed to VAT and customs recharacterization.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), constituted under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 249]; residual exchange-control powers remain with the Minister of Finance under the Foreign Exchange Act [Cap 180], with RBV-licensed commercial banks acting as authorized dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) operates a managed float against a composite basket (USD, AUD, EUR, JPY, NZD, SDR). Current-account convertibility is fully liberalized and capital-account transfers are effectively unrestricted for non-resident owners of a Vanuatu International Company; no RBV pre-approval is required for share capital injection or profit remittance. The operational obstacle is not exchange control but correspondent-bank de-risking driven by Vanuatu's zero-tax offshore classification, EU non-cooperative-list status, and historical FATF/APG increased monitoring, making clean provenance evidence the true gating factor for practical convertibility.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation applies in practice. The mandatory-conversion framework of the Foreign Exchange Act [Cap 180] has been effectively disapplied since the 1996 liberalization; no percentage surrender ratio, mandated conversion to VUV, or fixed repatriation deadline exists for software/services export receipts. SaaS subscription inflows qualify as foreign-currency services exports and may be retained indefinitely in a USD or multi-currency account with only ordinary bank statistical reporting to RBV.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign-Currency USD Account and Operational VUV Account
USD Offshore Desk Account with VUV settlement sub-ledger

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium (conditional). Vanuatu law does not prevent an International Company from using offshore EMI/fintech payment rails, but practical approval is uncertain: (i) Stripe does not list Vanuatu as a supported merchant jurisdiction, so SaaS collections must flow through a merchant entity or remote Stripe account in a supported jurisdiction (e.g., Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia); (ii) Wise Platform B2B, Airwallex, and Currenxie commonly reject or ring-fence a zero-tax offshore IC owing to EU non-cooperative-list and historical FATF flags; (iii) the accepted workaround is to maintain the Vanuatu IC as the master Treasury vehicle while the commercial merchant/collection entity sits in a supported payments jurisdiction under the same beneficial ownership, with full UBO transparency and documented software substance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory rule requires physical attendance of directors; the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2006 permits CDD through licensed introducers, notarized/certified identity documents, and secure video identification. In practice, Tier-1 Vanuatu banks require a recorded compliance interview with each non-resident director/UBO of an offshore IC and generally request notarized corporate extracts, a registered-agent reference, and a bank reference; fully remote opening is achievable within 4–8 weeks where a Vanuatu-resident signatory or an established relationship is present.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore zero-tax 'International Company' classification creating a shell-company red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; Certificate of Good Standing and current status extract from Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; registered-agent attestation confirming UBO records under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act No. 22 of 2020; board resolutions authorising account opening and signatory mandates; substantive-business file comprising executed SaaS licence agreements, invoices, and vendor contracts demonstrating genuine software operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction-level adverse flags: zero-tax regime, EU non-cooperative jurisdiction listing, historical FATF/APG increased monitoring, and correspondent-bank de-risking.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Layered remediation pack: VFSC compliance certificate and clean regulatory-standing evidence; accountant-prepared management accounts or reviewed financial statements showing recurring B2B SaaS revenue; completed counterparty due-diligence questionnaire with sanctions/PEP screening report; written AML/CTF policy and named compliance contact; tax-status narrative explaining the IC exemption as statutory ordinary practice for internationally focused software companies rather than abusive tax structuring.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Aggregated cross-border SaaS receipts via Stripe/Wise settlement pools treated as unidentified third-party payments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full payment-provenance bundle: merchant payout statements and currency-conversion logs from Stripe Billing and Wise; executed master service agreements and licence schedules matched to each material inflow; customer registration/KYC extracts identifying legal names, jurisdictions, and beneficial owners where available; CFO source-of-funds memorandum reconciling at least 90% of inflows to identifiable commercial contracts; archived invoice/PO repository maintained under the group's records policy for regeneration within 48 hours.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: (i) SWIFT MT103 from the investor's bank to the IC's foreign-currency account, with field-72 narrative 'Share subscription — paid-up capital' or 'Subscription fees — enterprise SaaS licences'; (ii) no RBV approval or VUV conversion is required, but the receiving bank screens purpose codes and may demand the investor's source-of-funds statement or the customer's contract/invoice; (iii) for SaaS revenue, settle into the supported-jurisdiction merchant clearing account first, then forward-sweep via MT103 to the Vanuatu IC Treasury account to preserve a clean audit trail; (iv) maintain a live counterparty register linking each wire to an underlying agreement and retain evidence for at least five years.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing architecture: (i) vendor, contractor, and licensing payments via SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the USD Treasury account through ANZ or BSP Nostro, with field-70 invoice references; (ii) low-value intra-group allocations via Wise Platform B2B batch payments and material dividends via dedicated MT103 following board approval and a VFSC/registered-agent signing checklist (no Vanuatu withholding tax applies); (iii) commercial letters of credit used only for hardware/enterprise-resale contracts requiring bank payment undertakings, not for standard SaaS collections; (iv) daily USD float treated conservatively and swept to an interest-bearing operating account under a board-approved investment and hedging policy.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla OTC foreign-exchange forwards (USD/VUV, USD/AUD) executed bilaterally with RBV-authorized dealing banks under ISDA-style confirmation; no onshore listed FX derivatives market exists in Vanuatu.
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD/VUV or USD/AUD cross rates with licensed international dealers, documented on a master netting agreement and settled in USD.

Cross-currency swaps (USD against VUV or AUD) permitted only to hedge demonstrable contractual cash-flow exposure, executed with a licensed financial dealer under the Financial Dealers Act 2008 and approved by the board.

Zero-premium FX option collars approved on a deal-by-deal basis for material disbursements; speculative derivatives positions are prohibited for an International Company absent express written consent of the licensed dealer and a board-approved hedging policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee Renewal (International Company annual government fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation; grace period of 21 days; after the grace period the company is considered delinquent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% per month or part thereof, capped at 100% of the annual fee; persistent non-payment for six consecutive months triggers VFSC administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance / Tax Residency NIL Confirmation (required only if the International Company claims Vanuatu tax residency or conducts a relevant activity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and Vanuatu Revenue and Customs on behalf of the Economic Substance Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the accounting reference date; for a standard 31 December financial year end, the filing is due by 31 December of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing may result in fixed monetary penalties, rebuttal of tax-residency status, and issuance of information notices; continued failure to comply may lead to penalty assessments and administrative strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not applicable. Vanuatu International Companies are exempt from statutory audit irrespective of revenue, assets, or employee count; no quantitative audit threshold is prescribed under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting framework is imposed; if financial statements are voluntarily prepared for management, investor, or lender purposes, IFRS or internal cash-basis records are acceptable; the registered agent must retain underlying accounting records at the registered office.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public UBO register or annual UBO return is filed for International Companies; however, the licensed registered agent must verify beneficial owners and controllers at incorporation, at each share transfer, and must refresh the internal AML/CFT customer due diligence file on an annual basis; UBO records must be retained for at least seven years after the relationship ends.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable — no statutory audit is required; voluntary audit prepared for investors or acquirers, if requested, typically ranges from USD 2,000 – 4,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — no corporate income tax (Income Tax Act Cap 284 imposes no tax on International Companies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero statutory tax burden: no CIT, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax for International Companies; offshore income and dividends are exempt; VAT (12.5%) applies only to domestic supplies, and exported B2B SaaS services are zero-rated; only recurring VFSC registration and annual fees apply.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No domestic income tax return exists for International Companies. Annual statutory compliance is effected through the VFSC Annual Return and Annual Renewal Fee under the International Companies Act Cap 222, submitted electronically via the VFSC registered-agent portal (e-VFSC) or by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annually (VFSC annual return / renewal); no quarterly or annual CIT filing obligations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Return and annual fee payable on or before the anniversary of incorporation (within the prescribed period under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations, typically within six months of the registration anniversary). No fiscal year-end CIT deadline applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent's name, license number, and full address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a VFSC-licensed agent physically present in Vanuatu; non-resident shareholders cannot act as registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC number, incorporation date, company name, registered office in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Company name must end with 'Limited'; registered office must be maintained in Vanuatu even if directors are non-resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of directors and shareholders with residential addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident persons may serve as directors/shareholders; no nationality or residency bar; details must be current.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 — Authorised and Issued Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Currency of account, authorized capital, issued shares and classes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital; shares may be issued in any currency; bearer shares are prohibited.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of solvency, compliance with the International Companies Act, and confirmation of no domestic business activity (or Economic Substance Notification if a relevant activity is performed)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors sign the declaration; overseas software/SaaS activity must be described accurately to avoid foreign permanent-establishment allegations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-payment of the VFSC annual fee attracts surcharges (up to 10% per month on arrears) plus reinstatement, deregistration, and strike-off penalties; continued default leads to removal from the Register, and restoration may require court approval and additional fees.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no dividend withholding tax, no income tax on distributions, and no capital duty on share transfers; International Company dividends may be repatriated free of any domestic tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and imposes zero withholding tax, so no DTA relief application or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) is necessary for outbound profit repatriation. Where a non-resident shareholder is tax-resident in a treaty country, the OECD Model limitation-of-relief clauses may deny foreign tax credit for Vanuatu tax because no tax is actually paid; a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing can evidence corporate existence for banking and FATCA/CRS purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate — no domestic withholding on cross-border royalties or interest remitted by a Vanuatu IC, and no treaty-reduced rate is needed given the absence of any WHT. Caution: license payments for IP made by a Vanuatu IC must be supported by genuine economic substance in Vanuatu, otherwise the recipient's jurisdiction may assert principal-purpose anti-avoidance or CFC rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Nil (VUV 0) — no domestic transfer-pricing documentation threshold is triggered because the zero-CIT regime yields no TP adjustment exposure in Vanuatu. Separate ESR filing threshold applies: every International Company carrying on a 'relevant activity' (including distribution and service centre) must submit an annual Economic Substance Notification/Return with VFSC, regardless of revenue amount.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu applies Economic Substance Regulations aligned with EU/OECD criteria (International Companies Act Cap 222, as amended). Relevant activities include banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing/leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, and IP holding. For a B2B SaaS IC, the 'distribution and service centre' classification requires Vanuatu-based management, employees (or outsourced contractors justified by substance), physical premises, operating expenditure proportionate to income, and a full annual ESR declaration; failure triggers penalties, deregistration, and automatic exchange of information with foreign tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the zero-tax IC to conceal income or misrepresent the place of effective management where the SaaS contracts, IP ownership, and bank accounts are actually managed abroad; knowingly signing false declarations to VFSC or foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu law (Income Tax offences and Criminal Code provisions), fines up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 12 years, forfeiture of unlawfully derived property, and deregistration of the IC; overseas jurisdictions may additionally impose criminal tax-evasion penalties and CFC charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face personal civil restitution for all taxes and penalties evaded, claw-back of distributions, and disqualification orders; travel bans and share-freezing orders may be issued by the Supreme Court; directors who knowingly participate in evasion are subject to imprisonment and are personally named in redemption and restitution orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SaaS business as a pure pass-through shell with no employees, premises, or active management in Vanuatu, or holding SaaS intangible assets without substance while claiming Vanuatu zero-rate benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC administrative penalties under the ESR regime (penalty per month for non-filing, maximum VUV 5,000,000), compulsory deregistration and strike-off, disqualification of the registered agent, and exchange of information with foreign tax authorities leading to re-characterisation and back-tax assessments abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors risk personal liability for penalties and restoration costs, director-banning orders, and an overseas travel ban pending resolution of ESR investigations; in liquidation, a court may pierce the veil and order the directors to indemnify the company's creditors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain accurate beneficial-ownership records, failure to file suspicious-transaction reports (STRs) for SaaS B2B payments routed through third states, cash-intensive or sanctioned-routed payment rails, or using nominee shareholders to mask ultimate ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019 (supervised by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit), corporate fines up to VUV 100,000,000, licence cancellation, transaction blocking, and asset seizure; repeat violations trigger criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, MLROs, and compliance officers may be personally fined up to VUV 25,000,000 and imprisoned for up to 12 years; the court may issue travel restrictions, freeze personal assets, and impose restitution obligations on individuals who knowingly allowed tainted B2B proceeds through the IC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Late or Non-Filing of VFSC Annual Returns and Fees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the Annual Return, pay the annual renewal fee, or maintain the registered agent and registered office after the incorporation anniversary.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Surcharges on overdue fees (up to 10% monthly), administrative strike-off and deregistration, loss of separate legal personality, and restoration costs; continuing default exposes the entity to foreign anti-abuse rebuttal of its separate status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly liable for outstanding fees, restoration expenses, and third-party liabilities incurred during the period of default; persistent defaulters receive director disqualification orders from VFSC and the Supreme Court, with possible departure bans if the IC has unpaid regulatory levies.
